FOUR ALTERNATIVES. FOUR DIFFERENT REASONS.

Apntly alternatives.
When simple appointments become more.

Apntly is a hard price benchmark for a straightforward appointment business: Pro is listed at $9/month with calendar integrations, group bookings and deposits. The reason to look elsewhere is usually a new workflow: rentals, session packs, recurring offers or a more involved location structure.

↔↔↔↔
Updated Sep 22, 2026Official sources & methodologyPublished by Cowlendar
The shortlist ↓Real monthly costs ↓Feature differences ↓
↳

What would make switching worthwhile?

Keep Apntly on your shortlist if one-service free bookings or the low-cost Pro plan already covers your workflow. Switching simply to get a longer feature list can add unnecessary work.

YOUR DECISION STARTS HERE

The differences that matter for Apntly users.

01

A narrow appointment workflow

Apntly Pro already lists calendars and deposits. A more expensive replacement needs to solve a specific problem.

02

Session packs or subscriptions

Cowlendar includes both in its feature set. Appointo lists subscriptions and bundles with a transaction-linked charge to include in the budget.

03

Rental date ranges

Cowlendar, Appointo, BookX and Tipo document multiday formats. Do not assume ordinary appointment slots cover the return-date requirement.

YOUR MIGRATION CHECKLIST

Test the reason you are switching.

  1. List the offer you cannot sell today Write down the actual need: a rental period, a class pack or a renewing coaching offer. Keep ordinary appointments as a control case.
  2. Test existing calendar rules Recreate a staff conflict, a group booking and the deposit flow. An alternative must preserve the parts that already work.
  3. Reconcile the upcoming appointments Confirm future bookings, customer messages and any outstanding payments before replacing the live booking entry point.

Apntly alternatives: common questions.

Is there a cheaper alternative to Apntly Pro?

Apntly Pro is listed at $9/month. Cowlendar is not always cheaper; its advantage is a broader set of booking formats and all features on the free plan within its allowance. Compare the required workflow and volume.

When is Cowlendar a relevant Apntly alternative?

When one store needs appointments alongside multiday rentals, bundles or subscriptions. Confirm the setup using your actual service and expected booking revenue.
